_note: Single source of product facts for the site, schema, llms.txt, lints and prompts. Public App Store data only. scripts/check-facts.mjs compares it with the live US listing; it may rewrite only rating.* and only when the 1-decimal value or rating.show flips (show = value >= 4.5 and count >= 20). A change in storeName or minIOS needs a human because copy depends on it.
installLine: Free to download; a subscription unlocks it.
